strategies.name: Suspicious Addition to Local or Domain Groups

analytics.name: Analytic 0865
analytics.guidance: Detects unauthorized additions of users or machine accounts to privileged local or domain groups (e.g., Administrators, Remote Desktop Users).

tuning.description: Set to detect high-privileged groups like 'Administrators', 'Domain Admins', or 'Remote Desktop Users'
Restrict detections to business hours or approved maintenance windows
Filter out known automated processes or provisioning systems

analytics.name: Analytic 0866
analytics.guidance: Detects unexpected use of usermod, gpasswd, or direct modification of /etc/group to elevate user group membership.

tuning.description: Focus on 'sudo', 'wheel', or custom high-privilege groups
Account that initiated the change (e.g., service account or unrecognized user)

log_sources.name: auditd:SYSCALL
log_sources.channel: SYSCALL for usermod or /etc/group file modification

analytics.name: Analytic 0867
analytics.guidance: Detects use of `dseditgroup` or `dscl` to add users to privileged macOS groups (e.g., admin).

tuning.description: Detect unknown or transient users making group changes
Detect group modifications at suspicious times

log_sources.name: macos:unifiedlog
log_sources.channel: Process execution or directory service changes
